mentions.name: Humetrical
mentions.description: A workplace wellness platform that puts employee mental health first by tracking and visualizing well-being metrics through a traffic light-style self-reporting system, helping managers spot burnout before it leads to turnover. Supports configurable check-in frequency, such as once per week or on specific days.
mentions.problem: Burnout blindness leads to exit interviews; companies offer superficial perks like yoga stipends instead of paying attention to employees' overall well-being.
mentions.audience: Companies and managers who want to gauge where their employees are mentally at and address well-being directly
mentions.source_excerpt: Humetrical ( https://humetrical.com ) -- A wellness platform that puts people's mental health first by showing work metrics that matter. Because burnout blindness leads to exit interviews.
